title: Medical Lab Scientist II
description:
**Job Summary and Responsibilities**

As our Medical Lab Scientist II (non-CA), you will oversee the day-to-day operations of an assigned shift or department, performing general testing within the analytical core laboratory, including transfusion services, and ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements.
  
  
Every day you will apply a high level of technical knowledge to department testing and clinical relevance, serve as a liaison with other laboratory departments and hospital services, and assist in process improvement initiatives. You may also perform phlebotomy and specimen management duties, consistently functioning in a self-directed manner.
  
  
To be successful in this role, you will possess advanced technical expertise in laboratory operations, strong analytical and complex problem-solving skills, and a proven ability to lead, ensure compliance (CLIA, CAP, TJC, OSHA), and maintain high standards of quality and efficiency within a self-directed environment.

  

* Performs and reports waived, moderately complex, and highly complex test procedures on patient specimens adhering to the Section's Standard Operating Procedures to ensure accurate and timely reporting.
* Provides excellent patient care through clinical correlation of results, identification of patterns of bias, rapid notification of appropriate caregivers of critical values, and completion of testing within established turnaroundtime limits.
* Performs required calibration and quality control procedures and maintains records to ensure tests are being performed within established parameters.
* Ensures that major automated equipment is operational by performing required maintenance, calibration, and troubleshooting procedures; including contacting of instrument vendor for assistance or repair.
* Assists department Technical Coordinator or Supervisor in preparation of QC and calibration reports, ensuring that records are complete and accurate.
* As a representative of CommonSpirit Health, utilizes professionalism and HumanKindness while communicating with physicians, hospital staff, patients, coworkers, other stakeholders in laboratory operations, and all members of the general public, whether in email, instant messaging, telephone, or facetoface interactions.

**Job Requirements**

**Required**

* Bachelor's Degree in Clinical Laboratory, Chemical or Biological Science
* Two (2) years of relevant laboratory work experience
* MLS with ASCP certification, or MT with ASCP, AMT, or equivalent certification, or specialty ASCP certification

Where You'll Work

Located in Lakewood, Colorado, St. Anthony Hospital is a Level I Trauma Center where we provide a full range of medical specialties and health care services to Denver and the surrounding region through our state-of-the-art medical campus and home base for Flight For Life Colorado. With four trauma rooms including the T-10 room, a dedicated field-to-surgery suite ready 24/7 for trauma surgeons and specially trained teams, our staff can provide life-saving care to the most severely ill and injured patients. In 2023, we received our exciting Magnet designation! We are so proud of our staff for this achievement, which is awarded to only 10 percent of hospitals around the world. Numerous other awards, certifications, and accreditations have been granted to us from the American Heart Association; Chest Pain Center (CPC); American College of Cardiology; The Joint Commission's National Quality Approval; the Emergency Nurses Association Lantern Award; NAPBC Accreditation; American College of Radiology and many others. At St. Anthony Hospital. We combine a heritage of expert care with the latest in technology and innovation. If you're looking to be part of a fast-paced environment where you can practice to the top of your profession in trauma, cardiology, stroke, neurosciences, breast imaging, cancer/oncology care, surgery and more, we invite you to apply.

 **Pay Range**  
$34.00 - $56.10 /hour

description:
University Staff

**Description**
---------------

**University of Colorado Anschutz**

**Department: CU Anschutz Innovations**

**Job Title: Data & Innovation Program Manager**

**Position #: 00854322 – Requisition #: 41663**

**Job Summary:**

The Data & Innovation Program Manager coordinates execution across two connected areas: the Pioneering Research and Innovation in Science and Medicine for Women (PRISM) program initiatives and broader strategic initiatives around data and artificial intelligence. Working within CU Anschutz Innovations’ complex, matrixed academic medical center environment, the role coordinates and operationalizes data-driven collaborations, clinical and translational research initiatives, collaborations with hospital partners, and other strategic alliances. The role blends operational execution, process development, relationship management, and strategic planning to advance successful programs and strategic initiatives.

The Data & Innovation Program Manager is responsible for providing operational oversight of assigned strategic efforts and PRISM-related initiatives, ensuring that collaborative projects advance institutional and programmatic goals, comply with governance requirements, philanthropic missions, and deliver meaningful, measurable outcomes. The role combines hands-on project management, program operations, relationship management, and strategic planning support.

The position will work across a broad set of research portfolios to coordinate stakeholders, support project teams and program governance, track milestones, facilitate reporting, and help move research and data-driven innovations toward clinical and practical impact. It is based within CU Anschutz Innovations but will be closely ingrained with PRISM research and program teams on day-to-day activities. The role will function as a central connector, relationship manager, and project coordinator who drives execution, facilitates program coordination, and ensures partnerships remain aligned with both CU Innovations’ and PRISM mission and strategic priorities.

Key Responsibilities:

* Lead the planning, coordination, execution, tracking, and reporting of assigned initiatives and partnership-related data & AI projects.
* Translate approved project plans into detailed workplans that identify deliverables, timelines, milestone, dependencies, risk mitigation strategies, communication pathways, and performance-tracking mechanisms.
* Coordinate across project leads, research teams, clinical collaborators, data and technical partners, and program leadership to support effective execution.
* Support program governance by coordinating project updates, documenting decisions, monitoring cross-project dependencies, and preparing materials for campus stakeholders, leadership, and committee review.
* Deploy and maintain program management tools, trackers, templates, dashboards, and other systems that provide visibility into portfolio progress, risks, decisions, and resource needs.
* Serve as a primary liaison and a trusted conduit between CU Innovations, PRISM program stakeholders, faculty, information technology, clinical partners, and other cross-functional teams as needed.
* Support the development of partnerships that help move PRISM research, data resources, and Innovations priorities toward practical application and patient impact.

**Work Location:**

Hybrid – this role is eligible for a hybrid schedule of 3 days per week on campus and as needed for in-person meetings.

**Why Join Us:**

CU Anschutz Innovations is an integral part of The University of Colorado’s Anschutz Medical Campus, a top-tier academic medical institution, collaborating with pioneering researchers, clinicians, staff, and external partners at the University of Colorado, staff at UCHealth and Children’s Hospital Colorado. Together, we power innovation by imagining, discovering and commercializing advanced healthcare solutions, including treatments, medical devices, and cutting-edge technologies.

Our mission at CU Anschutz Innovations is driven by the unique collaborative environment we operate in, and our guiding principle is to transform breakthrough discoveries and treatments into realities within an efficient ecosystem that accelerates their availability to patients. This approach not only empowers our partners to have an immediate and meaningful impact but also enhances the quality of life and outcomes for patients now and in the future, at both CU and beyond.

**Why work for the University?**

We have AMAZING benefits and offerexceptional amounts of holiday, vacation and sick leave! The University of Colorado offers an excellent benefits package including:

* Medical: Multiple plan options

There are many additional perks & programs with the CU Advantage.

**Qualifications:**

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, program/project management, communications, science, healthcare administration, or a related field.
* 4-6 years of professional experience in alliance management, project management, partnership management, research program management, business operations, healthcare innovations, consulting or commercialization or a related field.

*Applicants must meet minimum qualifications at the time of hire.*

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 6+ years of experience in alliance, partnership, or program management within a healthcare, biotechnology, academic, research, innovation, or medical environment.
* Experience supporting multidisciplinary scientific, clinical, data, or translational research programs.
* Experience coordinating projects involving multiple institutional and external stakeholder groups.
* Project Management certification.
* Experience implementing strategic operational plans and collaborating with leadership on complex initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience applying data analytics, business intelligence, machine learning, and/or artificial intelligence to complex projects, preferably within healthcare innovation, commercialization, biomedical consulting, or a related environment.

**Conditions of Employment:**

* Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without requiring sponsorship. We are unable to provide work visa sponsorship or employment authorization for this position now or in the future.

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

* Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with employees and stakeholders at all levels throughout the institution.
* Outstanding customer service and stakeholder-management skills.
* Strong strategic, analytical, and innovative thinking.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaboratively within complex, matrixed organizations.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, stakeholder groups, priorities, and dependencies across a portfolio of work.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with strong presentation and facilitation abilities.
* Financial, operational, and strategic planning acumen.
* Ability to synthesize scientific, clinical, business, operational, data, and regulatory perspectives into actionable recommendations.
* Ability to translate complex scientific or technical information into clear program plans, communications, and decision-making materials.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with demonstrated ability to document decisions, track commitments, and ensure follow-through.
* Ability to create structure and clarity for emerging programs whose priorities, teams, and operating models may continue to evolve.

title: Biostatistician - Research Scientist
description:
Research Faculty

**Description**
---------------

**University of Colorado Anschutz**
===================================

**Department: Biostatistics and Informatics, Center for Innovative Design and Analysis**

**Job Title: Biostatistician - Research Scientist**

**Position # 00854454:****– Requisition #41655:**

**Job Summary:**

Are you passionate about advancing public health through innovative research? The Colorado School of Public Health’s Center for Innovative Design and Analysis (CIDA) at the University of Colorado Anschutz Medical Campus is seeking a Biostatistician at the Research Scientist rank to join its team. In this role, you will collaborate with experienced faculty in CIDA and the Department of Biostatistics and Informatics. The individual in this position will consult and collaborate with investigators on all aspects of the research process, including the design of new studies (sample size and analysis planning), data management, complex programming, analysis implementation and data visualization, and dissemination of results. You will be expected to co-author abstracts, oral and poster presentations, and scientific manuscripts, providing high-level, professional, and scientifically rigorous design and analysis support to biomedical researchers at CU Anschutz.

CIDA is dedicated to expanding analytics expertise and research across the CU Anschutz Medical Campus, the largest academic health center in the Rocky Mountain region. This position offers a unique opportunity to work on innovative projects that directly impact public health while receiving mentoring and career development support. Over time, you will be expected to work more independently and apply more advanced methodologies to solve analytic challenges. As part of a dynamic team committed to research and public health practice, you will have the chance to grow professionally while contributing to the advancement of health initiatives.

Key Responsibilities:

* Collaborate on Research Design: Work with investigators to design new studies, including determining appropriate sample sizes, developing analysis plans, and ensuring robust study methodologies.

* Data Management and Integration: Oversee data management tasks, including data pre-processing and integration of complex datasets.

* Advanced Programming and Analysis: Implement and optimize complex statistical programming techniques using tools like R and Python to conduct exploratory data analysis, modeling, and downstream analysis.

* Visualization and Dissemination: Create data visualizations and contribute to the dissemination of research findings through co-authoring abstracts, presentations, and scientific manuscripts.

* Collaboration and Mentorship: Provide high-level design and analysis support under the guidance of doctoral-level biostatisticians, while at times mentoring junior researchers, PRAs, and graduate research assistants as needed.

**Work Location:**

Hybrid – this role is eligible for a hybrid schedule of 3 days per week on campus and as needed for in-person meetings.

**Why Join Us:**

The Colorado School of Public Health is a collaborative endeavor involving the University of Colorado Anschutz Medical Campus (CU Anschutz), Colorado State University (CSU), and the University of Northern Colorado (UNC). The Colorado School of Public Health is the first and only accredited school of public health in the Rocky Mountain Region, attracting top-tier faculty and students from across the country and providing vital contributions towards ensuring our region’s health and well-being. Collaboratively formed in 2008 by CU Anschutz, CSU, and UNC, the Colorado School of Public Health provides education programs, including a Master’s concentration in global health, innovative research that places the School in the top 20 in NIH funding among Schools of Public Health, and community service that addresses public health issues including chronic disease, healthcare access, climate, and environmental threats, emerging infectious diseases, population mental health, ONE HEALTH and injuries for the Rocky Mountain region, nationally and globally.

**Why work for the University?**

We have AMAZING benefits and offerexceptional amounts of holiday, vacation and sick leave! The University of Colorado offers an excellent benefits package including:

  

* Medical: Multiple plan options
* Dental: Multiple plan options
* Additional Insurance: Disability, Life, Vision
* Retirement 401(a) Plan: Employer contributes 10% of your gross pay
* Paid Time Off: Accruals over the year (based on percentage of time)
* Vacation Days: 22/year (maximum accrual 352 hours)
* Sick Days: 15/year (unlimited maximum accrual)
* Holiday Days: 11/year
* Tuition Benefit: Employees have access to this benefit on all CU campuses
* ECO Pass: Reduced rate RTD Bus and light rail service

There are many additional perks & programs with the CU Advantage.

**Qualifications:**

**Minimum Qualifications:**

*Applicants must meet minimum qualifications at the time of hire.*

* A Biostatistics, Statistics, Data Science, or related area of graduate level training at the start date of the position.

* Experience as an analytic consultant or collaborator in graduate school or post-graduate work.

* Experience with Type 2 Diabetes research.

* Experience collaborating in large NIH/NIDDK consortia.

* Experience with multiple NIH funded cohorts.

* Experience applying unsupervised learning methods including hard and soft clustering.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 1+ year of experience with data management and integration of data sources.

* 1+ year of experience serving as a biostatistician or data analyst on multiple projects.

* Demonstrated ability of successfully contributing to the analytic elements of multiple projects simultaneously.

* Proficiency in several statistical programming software languages.

* Demonstrated ability to work in a high-performance computing environment.

* Or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience that provides the individual with the required knowledge, skills and abilities.

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

* Strong knowledge of statistical principles relevant in medical research.

* Ability to analyze and solve complex problems and apply quantitative analytical approaches.

* Ability to investigate the properties of statistical methodology through simulation or other means.

* Strong programming skills in a common statistical software package (such as SAS, R).

* An ability to work with high-performance computing environments and cloud computing.

* Good organizational skills across multiple projects while managing self-directed workload.

* Positive attitude and the ability to work with a variety of biomedical investigators and colleagues.

* Ability to contribute to the growth and development of the CIDA and the Department.

* Strong written and oral communication skills, including the ability to be responsive and exercise humility while communicating appropriately and effectively with a variety of audiences.
